title: Jersey Mike's拟IPO募资10.9亿美元 消费类公司上市潮延续
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Sandwich Chain Jersey Munch is looking to raise as much as 1.09 billion dollars in an IPO.
segments.zh: 三明治连锁店Jersey Mike's计划通过IPO融资高达10.9亿美元。

segments.en: It's just the latest consumer oriented company to join the U.S. listing rebound.
segments.zh: 这是最新一家加入美国上市复苏潮的消费类公司。

segments.en: For more, let's bring in Bloomberg IPO reporter Bailey Lipsholtz.
segments.zh: 我们请来彭博IPO记者Bailey Lipsholtz。

segments.en: It's pretty cool to get a sandwich-based IPO after everyone was so excited about AI.
segments.zh: 在AI热潮之后，看到三明治公司IPO挺酷的。

segments.en: I'm like, cool. Real-world stuff is coming to this market. It's crazy how quickly things shift, Danny, right?
segments.zh: 现实世界的公司来了，市场变化真快。

segments.en: We're talking about record-setting debuts for SK Heinix, for SpaceX, everything around the AI structure build-out had been kind of roaring.
segments.zh: SK海力士、SpaceX等创纪录上市，AI基础设施相关IPO一度火爆。

segments.en: And now we're shifting is that fades away into the background into some consumer names.
segments.zh: 现在焦点转向消费类公司。

segments.en: So we do have the launch of Jersey Mikes. We are expecting potentially component farms to launch its IPO process in the next day or so as well.
segments.zh: Jersey Mike's启动IPO，预计Component Farms也将在未来几天启动。

segments.en: So a pair of consumer companies looking to go public at a time where they're still very much uncertain to you around the U.S. consumer.
segments.zh: 两家消费公司在消费者前景不确定时寻求上市。

segments.en: So then how does Jersey Mikes growth strategy compare with other fast food chain?
segments.zh: Jersey Mike's的增长策略与其他快餐连锁相比如何？

segments.en: Because you did mention that they don't have as much of an international footprint as, like, say, subway, which is why maybe that's where I know.
segments.zh: 你提到他们不像赛百味那样有那么多国际业务，这也许就是为什么我比较熟悉赛百味。

segments.en: Jersey Mikes is very much or is only focused here in the U.S. and in Canada.
segments.zh: Jersey Mike's 主要专注于美国和加拿大市场。

segments.en: But they brought back and partnered with their co- with the founder of the company to expand in the UK. So that's been their big pitch from an international perspective is using their roots
segments.zh: 但他们与公司创始人合作，重新进入英国市场。这是他们国际扩张的主要策略，利用自身根基来拓展英国业务。

segments.en: to build out the offering in the UK. We were actually talking on our desk today about like, okay, Danny, you spent some time living in the UK.
segments.zh: 我们今天在讨论，丹尼你在英国住过一段时间，伦敦真的有三明治文化吗？

segments.en: Does London really have a sandwich scene? California? Yeah, I mean, it does, but it's like Italian sand.
segments.zh: 有的，但主要是意大利三明治。

segments.en: So Jersey Mikes isn't Italian as well?
segments.zh: Jersey Mike's 不也是意大利风格的吗？
